newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb to cut 175 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb to cut 175 jobs.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said Wednesday it will cut 175 jobs in the United States and Europe, primarily in corporate staff, vision care and pharmaceuticals.

The cuts are part of Bausch & Lomb's continuing streamlining efforts. The company said it plans to complete its organizational analysis and plans for implementing its strategies by early in the second quarter.

"Our goal is to establish systems and processes that are not only more efficient, but also more responsive to the rapid changes occurring in the markets in which we compete," said Chief Executive William Carpenter.
"We are committed to moving aggressively to realize those opportunities, so that we can both reinvest in growing our businesses and provide a more predictable return to our investors.
"Our objective is to do this quickly and thoroughly so that the results of our efforts begin to be reflected in our performance in 1997," Carpenter said.
